title: Stochastic Restart 5-Layer with Localized Random Initialization
scientific_hypothesis: The 5-layer stack has converged top-layer thicknesses (indices 0-2 near 68nm, 32nm, 235nm) but exhibits high geometric variance in bottom dielectric layers. Localized stochastic restart with ±20nm uniform random initialization on bottom layers (indices 3-4) while fixing top layers should escape local optima and improve target score beyond 0.5922.
design_principle: Preserve converged top-layer interference conditions while re-exploring bottom-layer parameter space through bounded random initialization. This follows admittance locus method principle where bottom layers primarily control IR reflectance stopband position.
proposed_topology: exactly 5 finite layers from the incident side: Cr / SiO2 / Cr / SiO2 / Cr
manufacturing_considerations: Cr layer thickness bounded 20-50nm for adhesion and absorption balance
theory_basis: Admittance locus method for metal-dielectric multilayer optimization
expected_advantages: Escapes local optimum identified in iterations 14-19
known_risks: May not improve beyond 0.6209 historical best if 4-layer topology is fundamentally superior
Random initialization may require more optimization iterations to converge
execution_request_english: Perform one bounded TMM thickness optimization for an exactly 5-layer planar stack. Use the fixed material sequence from the incident side: Cr / SiO2 / Cr / SiO2 / Cr. Optimize only the physical thickness of each finite layer within the user-declared bounds. Do not optimize material identity or layer count in this route. Optimize a 5-layer spectrally selective absorber stack on aluminum substrate with material sequence: HfO2 | Cr | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2. Wavelength bands: 400-700nm maximize absorptance, 700-2000nm maximize reflectance. Normal incidence, unpolarized illumination. Thickness bounds: HfO2_layer1 [50-100nm] initialized at 68nm fixed, Cr_layer2 [20-50nm] initialized at 32nm fixed, SiO2_layer3 [150-300nm] initialized at 235nm fixed, HfO2_layer4 [50-150nm] uniform random initialization ±20nm around 80nm, SiO2_layer5 [50-150nm] uniform random initialization ±20nm around 76nm. Apply ±8% relative thickness tolerance for robustness evaluation. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer with stochastic restart capability. Maximum 20 layers constraint satisfied. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 400-700 nm, 700-2000 nm. soft objectives: high absorptance in 400-700 nm; low reflectance in 400-700 nm; high reflectance in 700-2000 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high reflectance in 400-700 nm; high absorptance in 700-2000 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layer count not exceeding 20.
revision_reason: Implements feedback directive for stochastic restart with localized random initialization on bottom dielectric layers (indices 3-4) while retaining converged top-layer seeds. Changes from iteration_23: fixes top 3 layers at converged values, adds random initialization bounds on bottom 2 layers.
